msgid: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!
LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.
I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!
We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!
Be a rebel!
Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!
Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!
You have POKéMON with you!\nYou're mine!
You deceived me…
The tunnel coming up is pitch-black\ninside.\pYou'll need FLASH to get through\nthere.
Who's that walking there with those\ngood-looking POKéMON?
Out like a light!
Keep walking!
I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to\ngo to LAVENDER…
Can't measure up…
Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?
Don't you dare patronize me!
No!\nYou're too much.
You're obviously talented.\nGood luck to you!
Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored, eh!
Keep it coming, eh!\pOh wait.\nI'm out of POKéMON!
You sure had guts standing up to\nme there, eh?
Hahaha!\nAren't you a little toughie!
Hahaha!\nKids should be tough!
I got up early every day to raise\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!
WHAT?\pWhat a total waste of time!
I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…
Hahahaha!\nBring it on!
Hahahaha!\nYou beat me fair!
Hahahaha!\nUs hearty guys always laugh!
Go, my super BUG POKéMON!
My bugs…
If you don't like BUG POKéMON,\nyou bug me!
ROUTE 9\nCERULEAN CITY - ROCK TUNNEL
You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.
Not good enough quite yet.
You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.
My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.
Not ready yet!
My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.
They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.
Aww, bummer!
Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.
Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!
Shot down in flames!
Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.
Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?
Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.
I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!
I knew it!
Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.
C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!
Arrg!\nLost! Get lost!
What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?
I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.
What?\nYou!?
Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.
We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.
Wipeout!
It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!
POKéMON battle?\nCool! Rumble!
You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!
ROUTE 14\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY
KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.
KIRI: Whimper…\nWe lost, didn't we?
KIRI: Did we lose because of me?
KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.
JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!
JAN: Eeeeh!\nNo fair!
JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.
JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.
EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.
Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.
Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!

Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!
{PLAYER} received HM03\nfrom the attendant!

HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!
You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!
I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?
{PLAYER}!\nYou and your POKéMON saved us!
Quit messing with us, kid!
A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!
I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!
You really got me!
Humph…\pTEAM ROCKET said that if I helped\nthem, they'd let me study POKéMON.
SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n3F
Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!
I'm stunned!
Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.
Enough of your silly games!
No continues left!
Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!
Waaaaa!\nI'm scared!
About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.
SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n10F

I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.
Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.

The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.
{PLAYER} received TM04 from\nSABRINA.
TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.
Your BAG is full of items.
SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.
In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.
Does our unseen power scare you?
I never foresaw this!
PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!
POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!
I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…
You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?
SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!
I lost after all!
I knew that this was going to take\nplace.
SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!
Ow!\nDown and out!

There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!
That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!

Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!
Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to check\nremaining time.
CENTER AREA
You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.
Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!
My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?
No pedestrians are allowed on\nCYCLING ROAD!
CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course\nby the sea. It's a great ride.
Excuse me!\nWait up, please!
How'd you get in?\nGood effort!
You need a BICYCLE to go out on\nCYCLING ROAD!
CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from\nhere.
MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.
REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!
There's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.
Burned out!
You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling them.
I could belly-bump you outta\nhere!
You heading to FUCHSIA?
I love racing downhill!
Smoked!
Are you looking for adventure?
Let VOLTORB electrify you!
Grounded out!
I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.
I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?
Why, you!
Maybe some POKéMON need element\nSTONES to evolve.
I need a little exercise!
Whew!\nGood workout!
I'm sure I lost weight there!
Aaaargh!
Be ready to fight for your beliefs!
Nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?
Shoot!
The slope makes it hard to steer.
Are you satisfied?
I need to catch a few z's!
It's a notice.\pWatch out for discarded items.
TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON are unique.\pEven POKéMON of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.
TRAINER TIPS\pPress the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.
ROUTE 17\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY
It's a notice!\pDon't throw the game, throw POKé\nBALLS instead!
CYCLING ROAD\nSlope ends here!

The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.
Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.
I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.
TRAINER TIPS\pThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.
TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\pZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.
TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.
Sssh!\nCan't you see I'm hiding?
Huh?\nTEAM ROCKET is gone?
TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!
Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!
My POKéMON is my loyal servant.
Darn!\nYou weak POKéMON!
The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.
Intruder spotted!
I better tell the BOSS on 11F!
SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n4F
Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\lWhy, thank you!\pI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.
{PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!

It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON.\pWe kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\pI think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS!\pIt's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\pIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.
TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.
We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.
It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.
Wow!\pYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?
You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\pYou came to save me?\nYou can't!
Uh-oh!\nI smell a little mouse!
Lights out!
You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!
Heheh!\pYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?
I'm done!
Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!
I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!
Aack!\nBrothers, I lost!
Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!
A child intruder?\nThat must be you!
Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!
{RIVAL}: What kept you, {PLAYER}?

{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here!\pI guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care!\pI saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!
Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\lROCKET!

Well, {PLAYER}!
I'm moving on up and ahead!\pBy checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\lhow they evolve!\pAm I a genius or what?\pI'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR.\pI'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER!\p{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\lSmell ya!
SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n7F
I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?
I lost out…
I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…
I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!
I had a chance…
Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!
Don't you dare laugh!
We like just hanging here.\nWhat's it to you?
Nice BIKE!\nHand it over!
Knockout!
Forget it, who needs your BIKE!
Come out and play, little mouse!
You little rat!
I hate losing!\nGet out of my face!
Hey, you just bumped me!
We'll always be hanging around here\neven if you don't like it.\pYou can detour to VERMILION from\nFUCHSIA going along the coast.
I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI need a punching bag!
Bad, bad, bad!
If I'm going to have POKéMON, they\nmay as well be ferocious.\pI'd use them to leave my enemies\nin tatters.
Hey, there!\nLet's have ourselves a good time!
Don't make me mad!
I get my kicks by harassing people\nwith my stinking POKéMON.\pThey're great for startling people.\nAnd, they bite, too.
Enjoy the slope!\nCYCLING ROAD
ROUTE 16\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY
JED: Our love knows no bounds.\nWe're in love and we show it!
JED: Oh, no!\nMy love has seen me as a loser!
JED: Listen, LEA.\nYou need to focus less on me.
JED: You have just one POKéMON?\nIs there no love in your heart?
LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool\neven in a loss!
LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry.\nJED is so cool.
LEA: Oh, you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you?\pDoesn't it feel lonely for you or\nyour POKéMON?
Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.
Huh?\nYou…

Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.
I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!
I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.

I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.

Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.
I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?

Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?

However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!

BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!
…  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!
BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!

{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!

I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!
Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?

Ah, so you are the much-
talked-about {PLAYER}.\pYou certainly do have the look of
a winner.\pBut for me to accept you as
a true POKéMON great…\p… …\pYou've still a ways to go!

All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.
It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!

Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s
fan…\pBut that means I can have {PLAYER}
all to myself!\pYay! Go for it!
My one and only {PLAYER}!
Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!

Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!
I wonder if I can become a cool\nTRAINER one day?

Oh, man, oh, man!
Cool! Too cool!\p…Huh?
No, not you.\pJust the way you battle.
That's cool.
Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLooks like I'm the only one left\nout of your fans.\pBut, you know, I like being an only\nfan… It's less stressful.\pKeep up and at it!
{STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh?\nI love the way he talks.\pI'd really relish a chance to meet\nhim in person once.

Huh, can you believe it?
Everyone turned into your fans.\pSo after all we've been through,
I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?\pEh, being the one and only
{STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.

Oh, my goodness!
Is it really you, {PLAYER}?\pI have to tell you, I adore the
way you battle.\pI hope you'll keep at it.
I'll be your number one fan!

Oh, my goodness!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pIt's so disappointing… I realized
I'm your number-one-and-only fan!\pWell, it can't be helped!
Let me cheer you on, at least!\pHurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!
Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on\nfire.\pThe way he battles… It's just \nthe way that I like it!

Oh, hello!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pLately, all everyone talks about
is you.\pI'm feeling lonesome because I
prefer {STR_VAR_1}.
Amazing!\n{PLAYER}, you really are amazing!\pInstead of just watching, maybe\nI should become a TRAINER, too.
I'm your only fan…\nSigh… This is lonely…\pCan't you try harder and make the\nothers take notice of you?
Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified…\nHe is so my type.\pWhy can't the others see the\ndignity he simply oozes?

I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1}
with all my heart.\pEven if I am the only one to
believe in him.\pI won't ever feel lonesome, though.\pNot if I keep thinking about Master
{STR_VAR_1}.
Hiyah!\pYour battling style is most\neducational.\pI hope that you will keep plugging\naway at success, hiyah!

Instead of just watching others
battle, battle yourself!\p…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out
like that…\pBut I won't let that stop me from
being your fan!\pI can't stop being your fan!

Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER
who has my respect.\pAnd that is none other than my
MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.\pYou should become a fan of my
MASTER like me! Hiyah!

Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the
FIGHTING DOJO.\pI will never become a fan of
anyone other than my MASTER!\pI will even sneak out of the DOJO
to spread word of his greatness.\pHiyah!
What do you want?\nGet lost!
BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!
Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!
SAFFRON belongs to TEAM ROCKET!
My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!
Ow!\nWatch where you're walking!
With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!
You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!
Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!
People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.
I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…
PIDGEOT: Bi bibii!
I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.
I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!
…\nSnore…\pHah! He's taking a snooze!
SAFFRON CITY\nShining, Golden Land of Commerce
TRAINER TIPS\pFULL HEAL cures all ailments like\nburns, paralysis, poisoning,\lfreezing, and sleep.\pIt costs a bit more, but it's more\nconvenient than buying other items.
TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.
MR. PSYCHIC'S HOUSE
SILPH's latest product!\nRelease to be determined…
POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pMany TRAINERS have scribbled their\nnames on this sign.

This FAN CLUB…
No one here has a clue!\pHow could they not recognize
the brilliance that is LANCE?\pHe stands for justice!
He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!
TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\pThat's you, right?
TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!
I heard a kid was wandering\naround.
It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!
We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.
Dang!\nBlast it!
We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.
Whaaat?\pThere shouldn't be any children\nhere!
Oh, goodness!
You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!
Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!
Cough…\nCough…
Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!
It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.
It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.
It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.
SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n5F

Those thugs that took over our
building…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for
strong POKéMON.\pI hope our PRESIDENT managed to
avoid trouble…

You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\lVICTORY ROAD so courageously.\pIn recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.\pWould you like me to teach that
technique?
I'll teach you the technique\nanytime.
Which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?
Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\pTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!
I heard rumors of a child prodigy.
The rumors were true!
So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?
TRAINERS live to seek stronger\nopponents.
Oh!\nSo strong!
By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.
I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!
I'm furious!
You showed me just how good\nI was…
Only the chosen can pass here!
All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.
RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!
RAY: Ludicrous!\nThis can't be!
RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…
RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.
TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.
TYRA: Oh, but…
TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.
TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.
Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!
Hwa!\nArrgh! Beaten!
Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!
Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!
Hoargh!\nTake your shoes off!
You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!
I hear you're good!\nShow me!
Judge!\nOne point!
Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!
Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!
